messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Convex geometry / affine-regular polygon stacking with explicit overlap proofs

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "Placing 13 points as the union of vertices from two concentric, affine-regular hexagons scaled at ratio 1/3 with relative rotation 30°, plus the center point, inside the unit square with outer hexagon vertices at maximal inscribed positions, achieves a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/288, where the minimum is attained by triples consisting of the center and two adjacent vertices of the inner hexagon; this is optimal among all convex-layer stacking configurations because any relaxation of the inner hexagon scale or rotation creates a collinearity-adjacent triangle with area strictly below 1/288, proved by tracking the affine-invariant cross-ratios of overlapping edge directions between the two hexagonal layers."}
